safety_principles: Adjacent segments may exchange gas across open pressure doors, but never share an elementary pressure-cell identity.
Pressure doors inhibit/partition flow when shut; a graph traversal is not authorization to equalize or pressurize.
HAB04 and HAB08 are whole-arc refuge volumes while REFUGE-space IDs identify equipment cupboards.
Crew learning/observations and sensor readings are distinct from world actual pressure.
Gross solid-envelope geometry is not available net free gas or emergency gas stock.
Unclassified rooms do not silently become breathable volumes.
F1 and F2 flywheel machinery bays are intentionally unpressurised, entered only via pressure-rated service locks.

pressure_access_closure.arithmetic: Child pressure cells retain distinct gas mass without adding their gross to an already-counted host arc.
